items.title: What to know about Paramount's settlement and its impact on movies
items.summary: Movie studio Paramount on Monday agreed to settle an antitrust lawsuit filed by 12 states, the last big obstacle blocking the company's $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery in a deal that would transform the movie industry landscape.  In the settlement, which still needs to be approved by a judge, Paramount agreed to terms including a five-year movie production plan and to invest $1.5 billion in domestic movies.  State attorneys general say the settlement guarantees investment in domestic movie production and provides worker protection.
